name: wp-soli-ticket-scanner-plugin
description: Public-facing QR ticket scanner for Eventin Pro events

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-ticket-scanner-plugin wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-ticket-scanner-plugin/languages/soli-ticket-scanner.pot'
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli -- bash -c 'php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-ticket-scanner-plugin/languages'
scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:make-pot && npm run i18n:make-mo
